title: PH must not sacrifice sovereignty for better ties with China – group

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines should strengthen its economy rather than compromise its sovereignty to ease diplomatic tensions with China, civil society group Democracy Watch said on Thursday. “The Philippines should not have to choose between protecting its economic interests and defending its sovereignty,” Democracy Watch co-convenor Lloyd Zaragoza said in a statement.
